messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: Sev2 — Per-tenant observability gap reported for tenant 'CorpX' in dedicated pool dp-3. Customer reports no traces/metrics/logs since 2025-06-08T03:12Z. Affected: metrics, traces, and request logs. Auto-created incident: INC-20250608-487. Please ack and triage.

Maya R: acked. got the page at 03:20 UTC from CorpX SRE, they say they can still make inference calls but nothing shows up in their trace UI and their support team can't pull logs for incident window. Filing root here.

SRE-Oncall: I'm on it — pinging @Derek H and @Carla P for ownership. Can someone confirm whether dp-3 has any recent config pushes?

Derek H: I was looking at infra events — there was a config roll at 02:45 UTC that included an update to per-tenant sampling policies. Rolling back but need to check diff.

Carla P: seeing 403s when attempting to read tenant log partition for CorpX in our log-store: "AccessDenied: kms:Decrypt failed". Looks like the tenant partition is encrypted with a customer KMS key that our runtime doesn't have access to in dp-3 (private key binding didn't propagate).

Maya R: that would explain 'no logs' but traces? traces route through our trace-exporter which uses the same partition key. CorpX is a VPC/private deployment customer — do we have a cross-account policy there?

Eng-Runtime: confirmed: trace-exporter process in dp-3 is starting but it's dropping spans with reason: "span dropped - export error: unauthorized-kms". stack snippet: ```2025-06-08T03:18:12Z exporter=otlp tenant=CorpX err="kms:Decrypt failed"```

SRE-Oncall: ok. immediate mitigation options: 1) request temporary key grant for our export worker to decrypt (requires owner approval from CorpX) 2) reconfigure exporter to route to hosted fallback (will expose traces/logs in hosted console, needs customer consent) 3) restore previous sampling/config rollback if recent change caused key rotation. Thoughts?

Derek H: rollback might not help if the KMS binding already rotated. fastest path: route traces to hosted fallback for 1 hour so we can surface backfill and give the customer visibility. To do that we'll push a per-tenant route override in routing service: ```POST /internal/v1/routing/override {"tenant":"CorpX","target":"hosted-fallback","ttl":3600}``` Need @Sales-Sean to confirm if customer approves hosted visibility.

Sales-Sean: pinged CorpX account team, they are online now. Customer says they prefer not to have data leave their VPC without explicit approval — asking for a temporary KMS grant. Sean will try to get a signed approval for key access now (ETA 10-15m).

Carla P: while we wait, can we at least surface request logs (not traces) by spinning up a short-lived log-forwarder that pulls encrypted partitions using a delegated session? There is an internal command we can try if someone with infra rights runs it: ```./tools/log-forwarder --tenant=CorpX --pool=dp-3 --mode=read-only --duration=30m``` I can prepare the runbook for ops to execute.

Maya R: @Carla please prep runbook and tag me. I'll coordinate with Sean and the customer for the KMS grant. Also updating INC-20250608-487 with latest.

SRE-Oncall: temporary mitigation in motion: Carla, can you also check if metric partitions are being written at all? I see metrics ingestion counters for dp-3 drop to zero at 03:12 in our global dashboard.

Carla P: metrics ingestion stopped for the tenant at ~03:11:57 — however host-level ingestion is healthy. This looks like a tenant-level partitioning issue, likely tied to key access. I'll attempt the read-only forwarder once we have short-lived creds. prep commands: ```aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/log-forwarder --role-session-name temp-corpx```

Derek H: FYI I'm going to stage the routing override command in a dry-run mode so it's ready if customer approves. Also adding a guard to avoid duplicating traffic for billing. dry-run: ```POST /internal/v1/routing/override?dryrun=true ...```

incident-bot: INC-20250608-487 status changed to "investigating". Pager assigned: SRE-Oncall.

Sales-Sean: CorpX legal/security needs a signed access artifact. They're preparing a short access letter — ETA ~12 minutes. They asked: can you confirm the scope of data the forwarder would read? (only service logs + traces metadata; not raw payloads).

Maya R: confirm scope. forwarder reads service logs (headers, status, timings) and traces (span metadata). It does not capture model inputs/outputs unless configured. Sending scope summary to Sean now.

Eng-Runtime: quick check — enabling a temporary debug flag on exporter for tenant to log decrypted errors will help validation. Command (ops): ```rbctl tenant set-debug --tenant CorpX --component exporter --level debug --ttl 1h``` This will surface more info to our internal console (not to customer). Approve?

SRE-Oncall: approve. Carla can you run that?

Carla P: running debug flag now. Also kicking off the read-only forwarder with our service account using a delegated session to avoid KMS decrypt — will attempt, results in ~2m.

Carla P: forwarder started, pulling sample window 03:00-03:30 UTC. First sample: able to read partition index but decrypt fails on object keys for some files. recording snippet: ```[03:24:05] file=logs/tenant/CorpX/2025-06-08/03:12:16.gz err=kms:Decrypt failed key=arn:aws:kms:...:key/abc123```

Derek H: got it. Once Sean returns signed artifact we can request the KMS policy grant from the customer's key admin. Meanwhile, because logs are partially readable (headers) we can reconstruct timeline for customer.

Maya R: customer update: CorpX appreciates the quick work, legal preparing letter for key access. They asked for temporary ETA to visibility — can we give them an estimate?

SRE-Oncall: with signed grant + ops run we'll have traces/logs visible within ~20-30 minutes. With hosted fallback it's 5-10 minutes but requires customer consent to move data.

Sales-Sean: CorpX accepted temporary KMS grant for 1 hour, legal doc uploaded to the shared drive, asked to confirm we won't persist decrypted artifacts. They signed off on forwarder.

Carla P: running final forwarder attempt with granted creds. result: success — backend shows sample spans now. trace id example: 5f2a9c1d... verifying against customer UI.

Eng-Runtime: exporter debug logs show successful decrypts now. sample: ```2025-06-08T03:40:11Z exporter=otlp tenant=CorpX status=ok span_count=42```

Maya R: confirming with CorpX that they see traces in their UI. CorpX: "we can see traces from 03:12 onward, thanks. This is enough to finish our internal triage." :white_check_mark:

SRE-Oncall: incident downgraded to partial-impact; visibility restored for tenant. Closing mitigation: 1) short-lived KMS grant used + forwarder run 2) audit log entries captured 3) routing override not applied.

Derek H: postmortem action items: - fix KMS binding propagation in dp-3 rollout pipeline - add canary check that attempts to decrypt a tenant sample after config pushes - create per-tenant observability playbook for VPC/dedicated customers. I'll open follow-up tickets and assign.

Maya R: I'll coordinate postmortem with CorpX and schedule P0 review. Thanks team.

incident-bot: INC-20250608-487 status changed to "monitoring". Assigned -> SRE-Oncall.

Carla P: leaving a note in the incident: KMS propagation lag was root cause, temporary mitigation was forwarder using short-lived creds. full remediation scheduled. :memo:
